sql: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS quando, payload->>'actor_username' AS usuario, payload->>'action' AS acao, payload->>'log_type' AS tipo, left(coalesce(payload->'traits'->>'provider', payload->'traits'->>'user_email', ''), 40) AS detalhe, ip_address FROM auth.audit_log_entries WHERE created_at > now() - interval '8 days' AND payload->>'action' NOT IN ('token_refreshed') AND (payload->>'actor_username' ILIKE '%castelo%' OR payload->'traits'->>'user_email' ILIKE '%castelo%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 150
